enrollment_frame.kernel_object: O_RDONLY non-O_PATH memfd; UID0/GID0 mode0400; F_GET_SEALS exactly15; TMPFS_MAGIC
enrollment_frame.authority: Existing explicitly qualified OS-root resource bootstrap only. Root object authenticity is not actor UID-only approval: complete measured fixed issuer/witness source/runtime/bootstrap profiles and per-job subject are mandatory.

proof_frame.payload: canonical ASCII JSON; no floats/duplicate keys

witness_bootstrap.apparmor: unconfined; existing host control profiles unchanged
witness_bootstrap.key: Fresh per-job ephemeral RSA3072; generate after PR_SET_DUMPABLE0; never persist/export/fork/exec; all key provider/DSO/runtime files individually pinned
witness_bootstrap.post_lock_policy: Irreversibly deny exec/fork and PR_SET_DUMPABLE reset; exact filter hash and actual key transition independently measured by fixed root issuer
witness_bootstrap.retirement: Key dies with witness; caller/lease/controller/guardian/witness loss stops signing and SDK fails closed; all own actors retire before canonical lease release

direct_after_receive: source/runtime/exe object fstat, readonly flags, complete hashes and source seals
Actual procfs lease-fdinfo reads plus existing readonly global /proc/locks
Live PID/birth/current public status and readonly namespace-aware cgroup VFS join
delegated_but_authenticated: Current /proc role executable before/after and complete maps/argv/environment
Original FDinfo and original target FD identity before/after complete source/runtime sampling
Exact sealed launch/context/current envelope and namespace identity
Witness own complete immutable source/runtime and pre-key locked bootstrap
prohibited_evidence: Self-written PASS booleans without original kernel measurements

allowed: Root-owned nonwritable runtime/executable regular file reopened O_RDONLY
forbidden: Any canonical lock-owning open-file-description even if O_RDONLY
Any mutable context/host file FD even if O_RDONLY
fd_policy.independent_open_description: Witness actual kcmp(KCMP_FILE) positive result; errno0, original and delivered sender FD/PID numbers signed. Failure/unsupported probe is BLOCKED; no Boolean fallback.

caller_binding: Witness reads actual Unix SO_PEERCRED in host namespace; compare actual stopped-exec/SDK script/image/source and namespace/cgroup to enrolled job. Never trust a PID/type passed by requester. Response caller equals SDK direct self kernel mapping; same time namespace mandatory. Client peer PID may be0 across PID namespace and is not an authority.
transport: AF_UNIX SOCK_SEQPACKET at a no-symlink readonly context parent; SO_PEERCRED UID/GID1000 and actual SO_PEERSEC=unconfined are redundant checks only. First packet SCM_RIGHTS carries enrollmentFD, proofFD and <=64 slots; later packets <=64. Exact immutable hashes/request SHA/batch order/slot census; MSG_CMSG_CLOEXEC; any truncation, extra/unexpected FD, EOF or timeout fails and retires.
live_bundle: Existing atomic live own/direct v3 view plus fresh signed SHA256 of canonical {guardian_self,host_direct}; views alone never authorize. Existing admission, whole-source, real proof/benign, rootfs readonly, namespace/cgroup and canonical lock gates remain.

runtime_inventory_distinction: Whole available input closure is fully provisioned/hash-qualified; every role complete actual used/retained closure and all file mappings are measured. No impossible all1346-FDs requirement.
